segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You grab the heavy iron clock-tweezers and slide like a hockey player across the slick river stones, ducking right behind the lead Nutcracker!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: With a quick, sharp twist of the tweezers, you jam the tool into the brass ratchet gear beneath the soldier's giant back-key and FLIP the switch!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The massive golden key violently reverses direction!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The soldier’s wooden head spins a full three-hundred-and-sixty degrees on his neck. His legs begin marching backward with double the speed:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the soldier bellows in complete backward reverse, furiously moonwalking across the vault floor!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He crashes straight into the second soldier, whose key also catches and flips in reverse! Within seconds, all three soldiers are furiously marching backward in a tangled, chaotic pile of red coats, wooden boots, and fuzzy hats, tumbling backward right up the stone stairs like a herd of confused dominoes!
